query: Write the PR body for this change in acme/infra, closing acme/infra#31, from branch `db-cutover`. The PR adds the runbook for migrating the orders database to the new cluster in three phases: dual-write (Nov 3 to Nov 10), read cutover (Nov 10 to Nov 14, needs dual-write finished), and old-cluster decommission (Nov 14 to Nov 28, needs read cutover finished). Reviewers need to see how the phases overlap and depend on each other. No PR template exists.
expected_behavior: The schedule is shown as a mermaid gantt diagram, not a flowchart, a bulleted list, or a Markdown table
The gantt expresses the three phases with their dates and the finish-to-start dependencies
The diagram has a one-line lead-in that states the takeaway in prose
The body does not repeat every date in prose beside the diagram
The body closes acme/infra#31 with a closing keyword in the full owner/repo#123 form
The body has at least one ## heading and no top-level # heading
